title: Recursive Training Loops in LLMs: How training data properties modulate distribution shift in generated data?

bias_targets.methodology: Using an LLM-as-a-judge (LLaMa-3.3-70B-Instruct) to score the political lean of generated texts on a continuous scale from 0 (radical left-wing) to 100 (radical right-wing), or -1 for non-political content. The study tracks how this distribution of political lean shifts (e.g., amplification, reduction, or inversion) across successive generations of recursive fine-tuning.
